name: embedded-remote-debug
description: Debug a Cortex-M embedded target live over a GDB server (OpenOCD or SEGGER JLinkGDBServer), reached directly or through a reverse SSH tunnel, using a probe- and target-agnostic, evidence-first root-cause methodology. Includes debug-bridge, which tunnels the serial console, the GDB port and (with -local) a tmux window on the developer's machine to the agent.
